$logging.description: Per-host log root paths (canonical host keys: MacBook, NixOS, Windows).

network.description: Named network endpoints exposed by this service (omit for services with no network interface, e.g. Unix-socket-only).

hostLogRoots.description: User and system log directory paths for one host. MacBook logDir uses ~/Library/Application Support/nucleus/logs (native USER root) for nucleus/logs consistency across hosts.

logDir.description: User-level log root. May use ~ (POSIX) or %ENV% (Windows) templates.

systemLogDir.description: System-level log root. MacBook uses /Library/Application Support/nucleus/logs (native SYSTEM root).

hostLoggingRoots.description: Log roots keyed by canonical hostname (MacBook, NixOS, Windows).

loggingEntry.description: Logging configuration for a service. Per-platform entry overrides the top-level logging block.

capture.description: Which streams to capture: all, stdout, stderr, or none.

dirs.description: Log subdirectories this service needs under each log root. Values are subdirectory names (may differ from the service key, e.g. 'caddy' uses 'https-proxy'). Multiple dirs are declared when a service has both launchd-captured stdout/stderr and application-level logs on separate paths (e.g. jellyfin uses 'jellyfin' for launchd capture and 'jellyfin-app' for its internal --logdir).

system.description: Subdirs needed under the system-wide log root.

user.description: Subdirs needed under the per-user log root.

eventLog.description: Windows Event Log query config for native services (ignored on other platforms).

logName.description: Event Log name to query via Get-WinEvent (default: Application).

provider.description: Event Log provider name registered by the service.

level.description: App-level log severity hint (passed as env var to the service if supported).

maxFiles.description: Number of rotated archives to keep.

maxSize.description: Maximum log file size in bytes before rotation.

sanitize.description: Strip control characters (ANSI escapes, \r) from log output.

domain.description: launchd domain (user agent or system daemon)

justification.description: Why this service is user-scoped when the policy default is system-wide. Required when domain=user.

prefixMatch.description: Match all services with this prefix

runAsUser.description: Service runs as the console user via UserName (not root). Needed for chown logic on macOS.

socketActivated.description: Service is socket-activated by launchd (e.g. sshd). Shows as "listening" in status instead of "inactive".

prefixMatch.description: Match all services with this prefix

endpoint.description: A single network endpoint with host, port, and protocol.

host.description: IP address or hostname the service binds to or is reachable at.

serviceRuntimeEntry.description: Service runtime configuration for one host

hostEntry.description: Host-specific service configuration with platform reference

prefixMatch.description: Match all tasks with this prefix

justification.description: Why this service is user-scoped when the policy default is system-wide. Required when scope=user.

prefixMatch.description: Match all units with this prefix

description: Registry of manageable services for nucleus-svc across macOS, NixOS, and Windows
title: nucleus service registry
